text.en:
The Committee is herby authorized to call
upon all government departments, bureaus, offices
and agencies for such assistance as it may deem
necessary in discharging its functions, particu-
larly the following:
a) Public Servico Commission, for rules and
regulations for granting certificatos of
public conveyances, rate-making policies,
latest documents on PSC hearings and
latest approved PSC rates on power, com-
munications, and transportation;
b) Securities and Exchange Commission, for
financial statements, past and current,
of power, communications and transporta-
tions firms;
c) Civil Aeronautics Board, for the same
data as paragraph (b) above; and
d) All other related agencies for data eva-
luation, review work and comparative and-
lysis of the positions of consumers and
public utility operators, and price po-
11cy determination,
The Committee shall be provided assistance
by a Technical Staff, to be composed of three
groups with the following functions:
Coordinator - Vicento. J. Brillantes, PES
Economic and Pinancial Group - to establish
the general and analytical framework, guidelines
and criteria in the context of broad developmental
and social objectives,
a, Joselito Gallardo,
b. Arthur Alvendia, , PES
c. Harry Pasimio, PES
.
Utility Operations Group
- to review and
evaluate the financial operations of specific
utility firms within the industry grouping.

b. Jaime S, Mejia, BIR
c. Ma. Athens. Flores; GAO
d. Pablo Bumanlas, GAO.
Rate Structure and Policy Group - to evaluate
the current rate-maling procedures and policy and
to recommend specific criteria for optimal rate
structure and policy.
a. Alfredo Kagavan,
b. Victorino A. Basco, PES
c. Francisco Caguicia, PSC
d. Redentor A Asprer, PES
The Committee shall submit its report to the
Presidont of the Philippines upon completion of
Done in the City of Manila, this Ist day of
February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and sovonty-one.
(SGD.) FERDINAND B. MARCOS
Fresident of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
